answer: A haven of per-task receipts records who did what, and the summit of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the wharf of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on time-locked work history, split across independent auditors, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work.
